info.title: Uptime Watch API
info.description: Sign up, add websites, and read their latest checks. Every route is rate limited per client IP; sign-up, sign-in and adding websites have stricter limits.

tags.name: charts
tags.description: Uptime, latency and incident data for one website

uptimePct.description: Up / (Up + Down) over the last 24 h; null without checks.

Latency.description: Response times of the Up checks; null when there were none.

checkIntervalSeconds.description: How often each site is checked from each region.

points.description: One point per bucket, oldest first; empty buckets have up = down = 0.

endedAt.description: First successful check after it; null while ongoing.

series.description: All sites together, one point per bucket.
